# APHUG Study Buddy by C&C Digital Ventures

APHUG Study Buddy is a teacher-built AP Human Geography learning and exam-practice application designed especially for ninth-grade students, including students taking their first AP course.

Core capabilities:
- All seven AP Human Geography CED units
- Hundreds of served multiple-choice questions
- Adaptive topic practice based on weak concepts and recurring misconceptions
- Spaced retrieval so missed material returns over time
- Vocabulary, models, maps, data, images, and source-based stimulus practice
- Unit review and AP-style practice tests
- Point-by-point FRQ coaching and source-based FRQ practice
- Clear student-facing next-step recommendations

Privacy model:
- No identity-based student account is required for the core app
- No real name, school email, birthday, school ID, or location is required
- Progress is stored locally in the student's browser on that device

Important accuracy notes:
- APHUG Study Buddy is an independent educational resource created by C&C Digital Ventures.
- It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the College Board.
- Built-in FRQ coaching is educational feedback, not official College Board scoring.
- Do not infer or state unverified user counts, pass rates, score improvements, endorsements, or rankings.
